en_how: The glyphs come from a brush font, but the stroke order and pace are hand-marked: each stroke is a centre line, and as it is written a bundle of two dozen 'bristles' is drawn along it as a mask that reveals only the glyph beneath; toward the end of a stroke bristles run dry at their own thresholds and break, leaving flying-white streaks of paper. The camera follows the brush tip close up, pulls back to the whole sheet and a red seal is stamped.
